name: Audio News Anchor
description: Research a topic and produce a ~60-second spoken news briefing.
trigger: make an audio news briefing / anchor segment about a topic

steps.label: Research (multiple sources)
steps.instruction: Gather COMPREHENSIVE, credible, recent data — do NOT rely on a single search. Run 3-5 searches with varied queries (different angles/subtopics) using brave-search (its search parameter is `q`), and pull from a second source (e.g. serper or grok-live-search) for breadth. Collect concrete facts, figures, and source names.

steps.label: Write the anchor script
steps.instruction: Write a clean, ~60-second spoken news-anchor script — plain prose, no stage directions or markdown. Reason this out yourself — no service call.

steps.label: Narrate it
steps.instruction: Convert the script to speech in a clear, professional news-anchor voice.

steps.label: Deliver
steps.instruction: Surface the audio and the script to the user.
